title: Neon Blocks
shortDescription: A guideline-accurate 3D Tetris with glossy glass blocks.
description: A complete Tetris rendered in WebGL with three.js: glass blocks, bloom, particle bursts on line clears and a neon arcade HUD. It follows the modern rules: a 7-bag randomizer, SRS rotation with wall kicks, hold, a ghost piece, lock delay and T-spin scoring. Every sound is synthesized with the Web Audio API, so it runs fully offline.
